units.rawText: Dolls are products of science, yet I, as a Doll, find myself bearing an inheritance of tradition. Even I can't help but find that a little strange.
units.displayText: Dolls are products of science, yet I, as a Doll, find myself bearing an inheritance of tradition. Even I can't help but find that a little strange.

units.rawText: Sweeping the yard, conducting ceremonies, praying for others, maintaining the texts... perhaps it seems boring to an onlooker.
units.displayText: Sweeping the yard, conducting ceremonies, praying for others, maintaining the texts... perhaps it seems boring to an onlooker.

spans.text: Sweeping the yard, conducting ceremonies, praying for others, maintaining the texts... perhaps it seems boring to an onlooker.

units.rawText: But to me, one must understand the traditions in order to pass them on.
units.displayText: But to me, one must understand the traditions in order to pass them on.

spans.text: But to me, one must understand the traditions in order to pass them on.

units.rawText: It is in seeking the records of the past in history books, following the footsteps of our forebears on long journeys and listening to the voices of the spirits that my value lies.
